notes: Apply winning map writes the RustMaps .map download URL, keeps a required WORLD_SIZE, and writes nothing if the panel would reject a value.
A failed automation step stops the steps after it. The run card names the vote that was applied.
A vote with no votes, or a tie, picks one of those options at random and says so on the run card.
Vote-end schedules follow the newest vote for that server. They run when cron calls php artisan schedule:run every minute.
2.3.44 keeps a MagicCore reload from removing other plugins' Harmony patches.
2.3.45 lets each admin keep the sidebar pages they use, and shows CDN image previews.
2.3.46 shows why a license key was refused, and ships MagicCore plugin downloads with the pages editor.
2.3.47 lets setup save the Steam Web API key when the settings row cannot be updated through the model.
2.3.48 replaces a PayNow API key without reading a ciphertext saved under another site key.
2.3.49 removes a Discord-linked role when the user is no longer linked or in the server.
2.3.50 reuses the license check and theme CSS so pages open without fetching them again.
2.3.51 lets the Discord bot unlink people who left the server or revoked access.
2.3.52 keeps Discord linking working when the browser drops the login cookie on the way back.
2.3.53 accepts Pelican Client API keys that start with pacc_.
2.3.54 ships addon rebuilds and keeps public pages from waiting on placeholders.
2.3.55 lets addon installs find Node the same way a template update does.
added: Wipe Management can record a wipe that MagicCore did not post.
changed: Home map-vote links use the latest vote for each server.
GET and POST /api/votes use the same handlers as /api/vote.
A blank Global SEO site title uses the site name before the template name.
The Pages SEO list keeps custom pages in path order after a save.
The home Discord count uses the Discord invite on the site, and the member avatars use the server widget when Discord allows it.
